scoring_justification: The equilibrium radius is computed by a numerical minimization; the checker cannot re-execute the agent's minimization code, so result-level comparison against paper-reported values is used.

outputs.description: Equilibrium nanocrystal radii computed via numerical minimization of the modified CNT free energy function, for all system IDs with available input parameters.

output_contract.notes: The scored output is the computed radius. The verifier compares each value to the paper's hidden gold using tolerance: absolute difference ≤ max(0.05 nm, 0.05 × |gold|). A directionally correct reproduction (meeting or beating the tolerance) earns full credit per row.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold equilibrium radii (R_sim) for each system entry as reported in the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table S1 (Supporting Information) of the paper: columns SystemID and R_sim
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's published supporting information table; values are the paper's own simulation results. The list is filtered to exclude the OA5 entry at 508 K which lacks C_np input.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact reported R_sim values from the paper's table; they serve as the hidden reference to which the agent's computed radii are compared.
